lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade talisman that projects an avatar of the user, complete with combat ability, while the true body remains far away. It is permanently consumed upon use and is an extremely expensive asset.

A legendary pill named after the myth of Nüwa repairing the sky. It is claimed to purify and improve a cultivator's innate spiritual roots, but its true effects are limited and it is notoriously difficult to refine.
A rare spirit spider used by the demonic sect to resist the extreme cold of the Void Heaven Cauldron's ice flame, enabling the extraction of the treasure.
The supreme treasure sealed in the innermost chamber of the Void Heaven Palace; the primary objective of the expedition for both righteous and demonic factions.
The third major stage of cultivation, where a cultivator compresses their spiritual energy into a solid "core" within their dantian, representing a major milestone in power and lifespan.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who are the two white-robed elders?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are Law Enforcement Elders of the Star Palace, the dominant neutral power in the Chaotic Star Sea. They used Incarnation Talismans to intervene without risking their true bodies.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Star Palace want to stop the cauldron extraction?
cultural_notes_faq.a: If the righteous and demonic sects obtained the Void Heaven Cauldron, it would dramatically shift the power balance against the Star Palace. By sabotaging the extraction, they maintained the status quo and preserved their own dominance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Han Li die from the flying sword strike?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. He survived because the jade ruyi treasure he was holding absorbed most of the blow. He was sent flying and his hands were injured, but he is alive.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Heaven-Mending Pill real or a rumor?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a real pill, but its legendary effects (like increasing lifespan or breaking Nascent Soul bottlenecks) are largely exaggerated rumors. Its true function is to help Core Formation cultivators condense a Nascent Soul by purifying their spiritual roots.
